scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn caragent_api.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd services/worker && uv run celery -A caragent_worker.app worker --loglevel=INFO
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter @caragent/web lint && corepack pnpm --filter @caragent/contracts lint && cd services/core && uv run ruff check . && cd ../api && uv run ruff check . && cd ../worker && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @caragent/web typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @caragent/contracts typecheck && cd services/core && uv run mypy src && cd ../api && uv run mypy src && cd ../worker && uv run mypy src
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @caragent/web test && corepack pnpm --filter @caragent/contracts test && cd services/core && uv run pytest -q && cd ../api && uv run pytest -q && cd ../worker && uv run pytest -q
